title: Testing Conditional Stochastic Dominance at Target Points
abstract: arXiv:2503.14747v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces a test for conditional stochastic dominance between two distributions at prespecified values of a conditioning covariate, referred to as target points. The test uses a one-sided Kolmogorov--Smirnov statistic computed from induced order statistics, the outcomes attached to the conditioning observations closest to the target point, and compares it to a critical value that, given the number of neighbors, requires no resampling, kernel smoothing, or parametric assumptions. The same procedure applies whether the outcomes are continuous, discrete, or mixed, and requires only continuity of the conditional distributions in the conditioning variable. We establish asymptotic validity under two frameworks: one in which the number of neighbors is held fixed, where the induced order statistics converge to independent draws from the conditional distributions at the target point; and one in which it grows with the sample size,

translated_title: 目标点处的条件随机优势检验
translated_abstract: arXiv:2503.14747v4 公告类型：替换版。摘要：本文提出了一种在给定协变量预指定值（称为目标点）处，检验两个分布之间条件随机优势的方法。该检验使用基于诱导顺序统计量（即与目标点最近的条件观测值对应的结果）计算的单侧Kolmogorov--Smirnov统计量，并将其与一个临界值进行比较。该临界值在给定邻居数量时，无需重采样、核平滑或参数假设。该方法同样适用于连续、离散或混合类型的结果变量，仅需条件分布在条件变量上的连续性。我们在两种框架下建立了渐近有效性：一种是邻居数量固定时，诱导顺序统计量收敛于目标点处条件分布的独立样本；另一种是邻居数量随样本量增长的情况。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需重采样或平滑假设、适用于连续/离散/混合结果的条件随机优势检验方法，并验证了其在不同邻居数量下的渐近有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a test for conditional stochastic dominance at target points, requiring no resampling or smoothing, valid for continuous, discrete, or mixed outcomes, with asymptotic validity under fixed or growing neighbor counts.
